# Auto Scaling Configurer Skill

> **Category:** Tech Skills

## Overview

Use when configuring auto-scaling policies for modernized cloud applications based on traffic patterns and SLA requirements.

## Quick Start

1. Copy this skill folder to your workspace under `.github/skills/`
2. Reference in agent files: `skills: [auto-scaling-configurer-skill]`
3. The skill activates automatically when the agent is invoked

## Structure

```text
auto-scaling-configurer-skill/
  SKILL.md    # Skill definition with procedures and standards
  GUIDE.md    # This guide
```

## Companion Agent

This skill is designed to work with the `@auto-scaling-configurer` agent from the Independent Agents catalogue.
